text: The home 5G device is stuck on 4G. The unit is on the ground floor. I've already tried the basic steps you suggested. I have client calls all day and this is hurting my business. It started since last Monday. This is completely unacceptable.
gold_steps: Check 5G coverage and cell loading for the installation address.
Ask the customer to reposition the 5G CPE near a window facing the tower and note the SINR/RSRP in the app.
Lock the CPE to the n78 band from the management portal and test again.
Upgrade CPE firmware and reboot.
Offer an outdoor antenna install visit if signal quality stays below -105 dBm.

text: Dear support, Wireless home broadband on 5G keeps dropping. It always happens when the whole street is online. This is urgent, I have a deadline tomorrow. It has been like this for days. Worst experience ever, I'm fed up.
gold_steps: Check sector congestion on the serving 5G cell during the reported hours.
Review CPE logs for handovers and detach events.
Switch the CPE to a less loaded band or carrier if available.
Log a capacity ticket if sector utilisation is consistently above 85%.
Follow up in 72 hours to confirm stability.
